values: Reviewed against the codebase on 20 Oct 2026. Source: project PRD.pdf and ERD.pdf.
Keep the current login, session, profile, logout, and CSRF flow working.
Session-based authentication is implemented. PRD calls for OAuth2/JWT with refresh-token rotation, so confirm whether the team will keep sessions or align with the PRD.
Serve the public plans, packages, and package contents.
Public plan API is connected. Keep its response shape stable for the company profile.
Provide sales-scoped lead list and detail APIs with status, notes, date, location, package, and assignment updates.
List/detail endpoints exist. Sales users are restricted to assigned leads; super users can assign sales-role users.
Provide the sales dashboard summary, pipeline counts, recent leads, and sales performance.
CRM dashboard endpoint is connected. It does not yet cover the broader ADM-003 executive metrics.
Add backend-managed portfolio, gallery, testimonials, and service content with publish/reorder support.
Showcase entries now support services, gallery items, and testimonials with publish/reorder controls in Django admin and a public filtered API.
Capture event type, guest count, budget tier, and requirements; send an inquiry confirmation.

Inquiry form and lead API capture event type, guest count, budget tier, and requirements. Confirmation email uses Django mail settings; local default logs to console, SMTP can be configured by environment.
Add Turnstile or equivalent bot checks and log/rate-limit abusive submissions.
No bot verification or submission throttling is implemented.
Complete the CRM stages and pipeline behavior, including consultation, scheduled, quote sent, and won-to-event creation.
The complete sales stage set is available. Sales can convert a Won lead into one linked event record; the conversion is idempotent and restricted to the assignee or super user.
Build customer history across leads, appointments, events, quotes, and invoices; add duplicate merge.
History and super-user merge cover existing leads, converted events, and invoices. Appointment and quotation history depend on separate tasks that remain To do.
Build itemized quotations with totals, PDF export, version history, and client acceptance.
Quotation and quotation-item models, APIs, and approval workflows are missing.
Require a standardized reason and notes before a lead can be marked Lost.
Lost status can currently be saved without a loss reason.
Add appointment scheduling, calendar views, status history, and staff conflict checks.
Appointment app has no implemented domain model or API workflow.
Create event records from approved quotations and add milestones, tasks, assignments, and overdue alerts.
The event app currently contains Plan, Package, and Content catalog models, not event projects or task management.
Add event-linked milestone invoices, due dates, sequential references, and balance tracking.
Finance-only invoice APIs support event links, milestone labels, due dates, and sequential references. Balance/payment tracking requires the separate Payments task, left To do.
Record partial/full payments and update invoice balances and payment status.
No payment model or payment API is implemented.
Implement configurable VAT, withholding, service charge, and exempt tax calculations.
Invoices support multiple tax profiles per line, including VAT, withholding, service charge, and exemption. Inclusive/exclusive calculations and saved rate snapshots produce a separate breakdown.
Apply role and action permissions across every module and API.
Every currently implemented API has an explicit public, authenticated, sales/super, or finance/super access policy. Modules with no APIs remain To do.
Add company, currency, timezone, calendar, and regional configuration.
No organization settings model or API is present.
Align domain models with the ERD, including Lead/customer qualification, Employee, Event, Quote, Appointment, Payment, and Expense relationships.
Current Lead requires a Customer; ERD allows an unqualified lead without one. Invoice currently links to plan/package rather than Event. Employee and several ERD entities are absent.
Set production authentication, HTTPS, secrets, encryption-at-rest, and backup/restore controls.
Development uses Django sessions and DEBUG mode. Production TLS, encryption, backups, and restore runbooks are not established in the reviewed code.
Add calendar invites or iCal/ICS synchronization for appointments.
Add run-of-show timelines and authorized post-contract scope amendments.
Add staff/freelancer records and conflict-safe event shift assignments.
HR app has no implemented domain models or APIs.
Add leave approval and attendance/check-in records tied to shift payouts.
Depends on workforce and shift records.
Add asset catalog, availability reservations, checkout/return inspection, and damage records.
Stock app has no implemented domain models or APIs.
Add maintenance schedules that exclude unavailable assets from reservations.
Depends on asset registry and reservation logic.
Add vendor records, compliance details, purchase orders, items, and event commitments.
Procurement app has no implemented domain models or APIs.
Add post-event vendor scorecards and average ratings.
Depends on vendor and event records.
Track event expenses and budgets, alert on overruns, and calculate event margin.
Expense models, event cost tagging, and margin reporting are missing.
Add an append-only audit log for key state changes with actor, entity, timestamp, and before/after values.
No audit log implementation was found.
Add date-filtered executive KPIs for active events, inquiries, receivables, and asset utilization.
The date-filtered CRM dashboard includes lead KPIs and active event counts. Accurate receivables require Payments and asset utilization requires Inventory; both remain To do.
Measure API response times and validate the PRD concurrency targets.
P95 latency and capacity targets have not been verified.
Evaluate client/vendor portals, local payment gateways, SMS reminders, and predictive maintenance.
Post-launch items from the PRD future roadmap.

values: Reviewed against the codebase on 20 Oct 2026. Source: project PRD.pdf and ERD.pdf.
Keep the Orthodox Ethiopian event profile, plan/package showcase, and responsive visual design.
The public company profile is implemented and loads the plan catalog from the backend.
Keep login, session verification, and session-aware sign-out behavior aligned with the backend.
Login page uses backend session auth; CSRF-aware requests are configured for lead updates.
Keep the CRM dashboard, filtered lead table, detail workspace, and lead update flow connected.
Dashboard and lead pages are integrated. Detail view supports status, notes, date, location, package, and super-user sales assignment.
Add admin screens to manage portfolio items, galleries, testimonials, and services.
Public profile currently showcases plans/packages; no content management screens exist.
Extend the inquiry form with event type, guest count, budget tier, and requirements; show confirmation state.
Inquiry form captures event type, guest count, budget tier, and requirements and shows an enthusiastic confirmation state.
Add CAPTCHA/Turnstile feedback and accessible validation errors to the inquiry form.
Add a drag-and-drop Kanban board for all PRD pipeline stages and prompt to create an event when Won.
Kanban board supports every PRD lead stage. Moving a lead to Won prompts the user to create the linked event record.
Add unified customer profiles with inquiry/activity history and duplicate merge tools.
Customer name and phone appear on lead detail only; no customer profile history or merge UI exists.
Build a multi-line quotation editor with totals, tax/discount display, and PDF download.
Show quotation revisions and collect client acceptance/sign-off.
Depends on quote versioning and approval APIs.
Require a loss reason and context when moving a lead to Lost.
Current status control has no loss-reason flow.
Add appointment calendar views, booking forms, statuses, and conflict warnings.
Show calendar invitation/sync actions for scheduled consultations.
Depends on appointment and calendar APIs.
Add event setup and task/milestone boards with owners, due dates, dependencies, and overdue indicators.
Current dashboard is sales-focused; there are no event or task screens.
Add invoice, milestone, payment receipt, balance, and tax views.
No finance UI or invoice/payment API integration is present.
Guard routes and navigation by role and show clear permission feedback.
CRM routes verify the session and sales/super role, show clear access feedback, and navigation lists only implemented CRM screens.
Add settings UI for company branding, currency, timezone, and regional preferences.
Branding and date formatting are currently static.
Add mobile-friendly run-of-show and authorized scope-amendment screens.
Add staff directory, shift scheduling, leave, and attendance screens.
Add inventory catalog, availability/reservation, dispatch, return inspection, and maintenance screens.
Add vendor profiles and event-linked purchase order workflows.
Add vendor performance scorecard entry and review screens.
Depends on vendor and event records.
Add event budget, cost, expense, and net margin views with overrun indicators.
Depends on event and finance APIs.
Add an audit history view for permitted administrators.
Depends on backend audit records and access rules.
Expand the CRM dashboard into date-filtered operational KPIs.
Dashboard date filters apply to lead KPIs and active-event counts. Receivables and asset-utilization views await Payments and Inventory tasks, left To do.
Add accessible interactions and configurable Amharic/English and local date/currency display.
Current interface uses static English labels and fixed locale formatting.
Add client/vendor portal, payment gateway, and SMS reminder screens when integrations are planned.
Post-launch items from the PRD future roadmap.
